paraphrase: In the whole universe you alone, Śrī Hari, appear in endless different forms — as the Self in the body, as light in the sky; as gold in many ornaments, one in the many.

original.text: akhila brahmāṇḍamāṃ eka tuṃ śrīhari, jūjave rūpe ananta bhāse
original.edition: recalled from memory; to be checked against a printed edition

location.ref: pada 'jyāṃ lagī ātmā tattva cīnyo nahīṃ'

paraphrase: As long as the principle of the Self is not known, all spiritual practice is false: bathing, pilgrimage, rites, rosaries and marks on the brow are in vain without it.

original.text: jyāṃ lagī ātmā tattva cīnyo nahīṃ, tyāṃ lagī sādhanā sarva jūṭhī
original.edition: recalled from memory; to be checked against a printed edition

paraphrase: Call him a Vaiṣṇava who knows the pain of others, who helps those in sorrow and lets no pride enter his mind; who honours all and speaks ill of none, steady in word, deed and mind; who sees all alike, has given up craving, regards others' wives as mothers, speaks no untruth and touches no one's wealth; free of delusion, greed, deceit, lust and anger — seeing such a one, seventy-one generations are saved.

original.text: vaiṣṇava jana to tene kahīe je pīḍa parāī jāṇe re, para duḥkhe upakāra kare toye mana abhimāna na āṇe re
